subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should OpenClaw add a supported structured usage contract to `session_status`, and if so which fields are stable enough to promise across transcript totals, per-turn cost, provider quota windows, estimates, and unavailable sources?
rationale: The requested capability is a new agent-facing API surface with privacy, freshness, and provider-contract consequences; repository evidence shows adjacent data sources but no existing canonical contract to extend mechanically.

options.title: Sponsor a scoped session-status contract
options.body: Add an additive structured usage object with explicit source and availability metadata while retaining the current status-card behavior.

options.title: Keep usage on gateway surfaces
options.body: Document the gateway/session usage APIs as the supported programmatic path and decline an agent-tool contract for now.

options.title: Split provider cost from generic status
options.body: Keep generic transcript totals in session status and route provider-specific cost/window reporting through provider-owned APIs or plugins.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a scoped session-status contract
recommendation.body: Add an additive structured usage object with explicit source and availability metadata while retaining the current status-card behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature-history evidence connects this person most directly to the current session-status and status-rendering surfaces.
